name: patient_has_suspicion_of_urinary_tract_infectious_disease_now@@complicated
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the suspicion of urinary tract infectious disease is for complicated cases.
when_true: Set to true if the suspicion of urinary tract infectious disease is specifically for complicated urinary tract infections.
when_false: Set to false if the suspicion is not specifically for complicated urinary tract infections.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the suspicion is for complicated urinary tract infections.

name: patient_has_finding_of_urinary_tract_infectious_disease_now@@at_risk
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the finding of urinary tract infectious disease refers to the patient being at risk for complicated cases.
when_true: Set to true if the finding of urinary tract infectious disease refers to the patient being at risk for complicated urinary tract infections.
when_false: Set to false if the finding does not refer to the patient being at risk for complicated urinary tract infections.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the finding refers to the patient being at risk for complicated urinary tract infections.

name: patient_has_finding_of_specimen_contaminated_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has contamination of urine samples.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has contamination of urine samples.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have contamination of urine samples.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has contamination of urine samples.

name: patient_has_finding_of_specimen_contaminated_now@@at_time_of_collection
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the contamination of urine samples occurred at the time of collection.
when_true: Set to true if the contamination of urine samples occurred at the time of collection.
when_false: Set to false if the contamination of urine samples did not occur at the time of collection.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the contamination occurred at the time of collection.
